scope: read-only replay of the preserved C2 PPO update-20 row 21 artifact using the integrated source checkout; no training, optimizer, simulator, checkpoint writes, or campaign artifact changes

reproduction.replay: Load the input PT with torch.load(map_location='cpu', weights_only=False); instantiate make_meco_track('C2', candidate_features=len(payload['row']['candidate_set'].table.feature_names)); load payload['model_state_dict']; move model and row tensors to cuda:0; under torch.no_grad(), repeat ten times: call _policy_inputs_for_row('C2', model, row, row['hidden_before'], MecoTrainConfig(track='C2', device='cuda:0')), then compute categorical_from_candidate_logits(decision['logits']).log_prob(row['action']).reshape(()). Assert torch.equal for all logits/logprobs and assert the first logprob equals payload['row']['logprob'].

validation_limits: This is a single preserved-row forward replay, not a simulator evaluation or assessment of policy quality.
The replay reads campaign artifacts but writes no files under the campaign directory.
